summary: Phase H (FR/EN auto-translator) verified end-to-end via Playwright. All 6 scenarios from the review request PASS. (1) Admin dashboard EN: after login as seffabdallah7@gmail.com and setting localStorage.lang='en' + reload, the sidebar renders 'Dashboard','Job offers','Applications','Contracts','Interview agenda','Users','Messages','Meeting room','Recordings','Appearance','Log out' and the stat cards render 'Active offers','Candidates','Pending','Active contracts','Upcoming interviews','Accepted','Rejected' (100% of expected labels found; 0 residual FR labels among the requested set). (2) Reverse to FR (localStorage.lang='fr' + reload) fully restores every French label; zero EN leakage. (3) Candidate dashboard EN: after fresh registration and switch to EN, sidebar shows 'Home','My applications','My interviews','Contracts obtained','My profile' and the 'New application' button; the offers page heading shows 'AVAILABLE OFFERS' (uppercase via CSS of the mapped 'Available offers'), search placeholder is 'Search an offer...', and every card CTA reads 'Apply'. (4) Public/regression: navbar shows 'Jobs' and 'Sign in' in EN via i18next, no double-translation glitches (also toggled 4x FR<->EN rapidly on Landing, zero console errors, layout stable). (5) Dynamic data integrity: job titles 'Développeur React Senior', 'Data Analyst', 'Designer UI/UX', 'Téléconseiller(ère) Anglophone', 'Enseignant(e)', company names (ACME, InsightLab, PixelForge) and candidate names are preserved unchanged in EN. (6) Stability: no console errors, no flicker; MutationObserver correctly re-translates new nodes when navigating between admin sections (Applications, Contracts, Messages, Meeting room, Recordings all show EN sidebar+headings after nav).

critical_code_review_comments: useAutoTranslate: MutationObserver only re-translates when lang==='en'; if a user is in EN and switches to FR without a reload the runFull() handler on languageChanged does the reverse walk, which works — but subsequent added nodes in FR mode won''t be re-touched (that is correct, since native strings are French). Good.

The FR->EN dictionary is only exact whole-text-node match. Any FR label wrapped by icons/spans that split the text across multiple text nodes (e.g. 'Nouveau' inside a button with an icon) will still match; but a label rendered as '{count} publications' or '{count} offres' will not — this is expected but should be documented so E1 doesn''t chase phantom misses.

There is no data-testid on the FR/EN switcher''s parent when placed inside a non-public layout — currently only rendered by the public Navbar (LanguageSwitcher.jsx), so admin/candidate cannot toggle from within their dashboards without a reload trick.

uiDict.js has both 'Acceptée'/'Refusée' (feminine singular, candidate) and 'Acceptées'/'Refusées' (feminine plural, admin) — good; but a stray 'En attente' is reused twice with same mapping which is fine, just noting duplicate stat semantics between candidate and admin.
AdminDashboard.js remains >1200 lines — carry-over from iteration 13, still recommended to split.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase H auto-translator is functional and reversible. To switch language in internal dashboards use: `await page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('lang','en')"); await page.reload()` — there is NO LanguageSwitcher inside /admin or /dashboard layouts (only in public Navbar). Login form testids are auth-email / auth-password / captcha-input / auth-submit-btn (NOT login-email). Register uses register-name + auth-email + auth-password. Candidate sidebar testids not scanned in this run; the auto-translator mutates innerText not React children, so use `page.evaluate(() => document.body.innerText)` to assert labels. CSS text-transform:uppercase (used on 'CANDIDATE SPACE') means substring checks should use uppercase form when needed. Job card badges (Temps plein/Télétravail/etc.) are not in uiDict — that is a known dictionary gap, not a bug.
